Done. Here's where UK Suspense landed:

**Cleared — 7 items, £3,930.18** (each with its receipt attached, all tying penny-for-penny to the bank feed and the March statement):

| Item | £ | Coded to |
|---|---|---|
| Trainline rail | 84.60 | 6300 Travel |
| Premier Inn (customer workshop) | 212.00 | 6300 Travel |
| Dishoom team dinner | 96.40 | 6310 Meals & Entertainment |
| Atlassian monthly sub | 365.00 | 6200 Software Subscriptions |
| Apple MacBook Pro | 2,349.00 | **1500 Computer Equipment** |
| Ryman supplies | 43.18 | 6600 Office Supplies |
| Google Ads | 780.00 | 6410 Advertising |

**Two calls worth your attention:**

1. **The MacBook capitalizes.** £2,349 at the March policy rate of 1.25 is USD 2,936 — over the USD 2,500 threshold. Per policy, depreciation starts the month *after* acquisition, so there's **no March depreciation on it**; it needs adding to the UK fixed asset register at £65.25/month from April. Your March depreciation entry should stay at the existing £1,150 run rate.
2. **Atlassian stays an expense** — the receipt says monthly, so it doesn't span future periods and prepaid treatment doesn't apply.

Also note the receipts show no VAT split, so nothing went to 2500. If you want input VAT recovery on these, we'll need proper VAT invoices from the merchants.

**Couldn't clear — £3,840.00** (EXC-001): the 03-17 faster payment "REF 88213 KLM CONSULT". There is no bill, contract, SOW, statement, or email for that counterparty anywhere in the document store, and no matching AP balance. I couldn't determine the account, the service period, or VAT treatment, so I left it sitting in 2900 rather than forcing it out. Beyond just coding it, I'd suggest confirming the payment was actually authorized — it's a one-off faster payment to a name with zero other activity in the ledger, which is a pattern worth a second look.

Two housekeeping notes: the original bank-feed entries had *no* support attached at all, so I remediated that for the seven I cleared; and I matched those eight bank lines, but the other 22 UK March lines are still unmatched — the bank rec item is broader than this task and I left it open, along with the rest of the checklist, since Suspense isn't fully clear until EXC-001 is resolved.
